payload.reason: The old test asserted card-based output and a gate that closes while a question waits, both of which SR-223 now rules out (questions go through the question tool, never a card, and a waiting question must not block unrelated edits), so moving to gap_questions and asserting the gate stays open matches the requirement; the dropped assumption and readback-text assertions weaken coverage somewhat, which keeps this from being certain.
